rationale: The original entry thesis relied on tight consolidation between $20.28 and $20.40 and price remaining cleanly above the 5-minute 9-EMA. At $20.14, the stock has broken down from that consolidation range and fallen below the 5-minute 9-EMA ($20.17) after failing to push past $20.41. With momentum shifting downward and daily loss budget constrained, exiting early preserves capital rather than waiting for the $19.86 hard invalidation.
